name: Crawfish & Lobster Bisque with Roasted Corn-Chili Relish ('Til We Meet Again)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Disney Magic · 'Til We Meet Again Menu
whyItWorks: The strained lobster and crawfish bisque base is completely smooth; only the central garnish of corn-chili relish is rough.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask your server to serve the Crawfish & Lobster Bisque plain without the roasted corn-chili relish garnish, and take a Lactaid.
watchOuts: Whole corn kernels and chili in the relish garnish (order without garnish)
